# The Map Room's class maps (journal_map_classes.py): every pop type's people, counted in Demographics' yearly
# walk (te_demog_walks, te_demog_effects.txt) through te_jmap_walk_init, _pop and _store
# (te_journal_map_effects.txt), whatever the rule, as Armed Forces' soldiers are, and stored as te_dg_cls_<pop>.
# Calls of the Map Room's own, not the census's helpers, which set nothing outside the census
# (test_demographics_registry.py, TestWorkWalk); test_demographics_golden.py leaves them out of the walk it pins.

# State scope, before the walk's pop loop.
te_jmap_class_walk_init = {

}

# Pop scope, in the walk's pop loop: one class each, the classes with the most pops asked first.
te_jmap_class_walk_pop = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_pop_type = peasants }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_jmap_w_peasants add = total_size }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_pop_type = laborers }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_jmap_w_laborers add = total_size }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_pop_type = farmers }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_jmap_w_farmers add = total_size }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_pop_type = slaves }

		limit = { is_pop_type = machinists }

	else_if = {

		limit = { is_pop_type = clergymen }

# State scope, after the walk's pop loop. The tenth pass's four share maps read other names until #1975
# (te_dg_soldiers already meant Soldiers and Officers, so every class took te_dg_cls_<pop>): a save that
# still holds them loses them here.
te_jmap_class_walk_store = {
	set_variable = { name = te_dg_cls_peasants value = local_var:te_jmap_w_peasants }
	set_variable = { name = te_dg_cls_laborers value = local_var:te_jmap_w_laborers }
	set_variable = { name = te_dg_cls_farmers value = local_var:te_jmap_w_farmers }
	set_variable = { name = te_dg_cls_slaves value = local_var:te_jmap_w_slaves }
	set_variable = { name = te_dg_cls_machinists value = local_var:te_jmap_w_machinists }
	set_variable = { name = te_dg_cls_clerks value = local_var:te_jmap_w_clerks }
	set_variable = { name = te_dg_cls_shopkeepers value = local_var:te_jmap_w_shopkeepers }
	set_variable = { name = te_dg_cls_soldiers value = local_var:te_jmap_w_soldiers }
	set_variable = { name = te_dg_cls_clergymen value = local_var:te_jmap_w_clergymen }
	set_variable = { name = te_dg_cls_aristocrats value = local_var:te_jmap_w_aristocrats }
	set_variable = { name = te_dg_cls_bureaucrats value = local_var:te_jmap_w_bureaucrats }
	set_variable = { name = te_dg_cls_officers value = local_var:te_jmap_w_officers }
	set_variable = { name = te_dg_cls_engineers value = local_var:te_jmap_w_engineers }
	set_variable = { name = te_dg_cls_academics value = local_var:te_jmap_w_academics }
	set_variable = { name = te_dg_cls_capitalists value = local_var:te_jmap_w_capitalists }
	set_variable = { name = te_dg_cls_spacers value = local_var:te_jmap_w_spacers }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_capitalists }
		remove_variable = te_dg_capitalists
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_aristocrats }
		remove_variable = te_dg_aristocrats
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_clergy }
		remove_variable = te_dg_clergy
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_academics }
		remove_variable = te_dg_academics
	}
}

# Map Options' Count/Share switch, just set (te_jmap_set_class_mode, te_journal_map_effects.txt): a class map
# on the page moves to the same class's other map, its people or its share. Country scope, the player's.
te_jmap_class_flip = {
